title: EV Charging Cashback Counting Schedule for Cartwise Shopper Payouts Closing Settlements
content:
**Schedule of EV charging cashback counted at a card-plan closing — Cartwise Shopper Payouts, Everyday Pay Card plans**

When a Cartwise Shopper Payouts card-plan account is closed and its latest unpaid statement month is settled onto the Everyday Pay Card, how that month's EV charging cashback counts at closing depends on the shopper's Cartwise+ Membership: a shopper holding an active Cartwise+ Premier Annual or Cartwise+ Family Annual membership has the month's EV charging cashback counted twice, a shopper holding any other active Cartwise+ membership has it counted one and a half times, and a shopper with no active Cartwise+ membership has it counted as earned; the counted figure is rounded to the cent.

The counted figure is the EV charging cashback that enters the month's total at closing, in place of the EV charging cashback as earned. Fuel and auto maintenance cashback are not affected by this schedule.

| Shopper's Cartwise+ Membership (status active) | EV charging cashback counted at closing |
|---|---|
| Cartwise+ Premier Annual | earned EV charging cashback multiplied by 2, rounded to the cent |
| Cartwise+ Family Annual | earned EV charging cashback multiplied by 2, rounded to the cent |
| Any other Cartwise+ plan (Cartwise+ Assist Monthly, Cartwise+ Student Monthly, Cartwise+ Monthly, Cartwise+ Annual) | earned EV charging cashback multiplied by 1.5, rounded to the cent |
| No active Cartwise+ Membership | earned EV charging cashback as earned; no increase applies |

**Reading the records.** The membership that counts is the shopper's Cartwise+ Membership whose status is active on the day of the closing; the plan name on that membership decides the row. A membership that is not active does not count, and a shopper without an active membership falls in the last row.

**Hypothetical illustrations** (figures invented for explanation only):

- Earned EV charging cashback 6.10; active Cartwise+ Family Annual membership: counted as 12.20.
- Earned EV charging cashback 3.34; active Cartwise+ Monthly membership: 3.34 multiplied by 1.5 is counted as 5.01.
- Earned EV charging cashback 3.34; no active Cartwise+ Membership: counted as 3.34.
